brief:
Emmy award-winning actor Tatiana Maslany discussed her advocacy for Palestine in an interview with Zeteo, alongside criticism of artificial intelligence use in the entertainment industry. Maslany characterized AI adoption in Hollywood as "idiotic" while addressing her public support for Palestinian causes.

The actor also compared Canada and the United States in the conversation, suggesting the countries are more similar than commonly assumed rather than presenting Canada as distinctly superior to its southern neighbor.
dek: The Emmy award-winning actor joined WNK to speak about her advocacy for Palestine, why AI in Hollywood is “idiotic,” and explains why Canada actually isn’t that much better than the U.S.
title: Tatiana Maslany speaks out on Palestine, AI in Hollywood
